verdict_reason: 59 sources carry 7470 hidden lines and reading them moves a published count (pairs +2) but no pointer-only reader class

rules.recovery: a line is recovered when the real tokenizer finds a token on it that is not STRING/COMMENT/NL/NEWLINE/INDENT/DEDENT/ENCODING/ENDMARKER and the corpus helper does not show that line number
rules.helper_failure: the helper flips into doc mode on a line that *starts* with a triple quote and carries an odd count of them; a continuation line that opens with a closing delimiter is read as an opener, and the flag re-synchronises one literal later in the wrong phase
rules.reprice: E331's own build() is run twice over the same file list, once with the shipped helper and once with a tokenizer-backed one; the patched helper is restored in a finally block and the restore is asserted
rules.no_silent_substitution: the recovered text is never used to overwrite a published face; the delta is reported beside the shipped numbers

limits.tokenizer_truth: the tokenizer answers 'is this line code', not 'would this module import'; a file with a genuinely unterminated literal stops the stream and is disclosed as stream_ended_early
limits.single_consumer: only E331 is re-priced.  E326/E328/E329/E330 read the same helper, so their counts are floors of the same shape but are not re-derived here
limits.face_level: the recovery classifies lines by shape (def / class / path literal / load call / selftest mention); it does not execute them
